name: Experienced Hound

items.name: Humane Bite
items.text: The experienced hound doesn't take a penalty to make a nonlethal attack with its jaws.

items.name: Pack Attack
items.text: The hound's Strikes deal 2d6 extra damage to creatures within the reach of at least two of the hound's allies.

items.name: Drag
items.text:
Requirements The experienced hound is adjacent to a Prone creature

---
Effect The experienced hound attempts an Athletics check to grapple the prone creature. The experienced hound can then Step away from the target; if the target is Grabbed by the hound, it is moved into the hound's previous square and remains grabbed.

text: An experienced hound has been on dozens of hunts. They are often raised from pups to catch the scents of certain animals and deliver their bodies unharmed when taken down by their owners. An experienced hound could accompany a hunter or other NPC who specializes in tracking down prey.
